children: On August 27, 2026, the company received Nasdaq deficiency notices for failing to maintain at least 500,000 publicly held shares under Listing Rule 5550(a)(4) and for its market value of listed securities being below $35 million for 30 consecutive business days under Rule 5550(b)(2). The company has until October 12, 2026 to submit a plan for the public float issue and until February 23, 2027 to have MVLS at or above $35 million for at least 10 consecutive business days. The notices have no immediate effect on the listing or trading of its securities.
